Quiddity admits of three ways of being considered in relation to the particular features that accompany it: it may be taken subject to the condition of something, subject to the condition of exclusion…
Quiddity subject to the condition of something is called “mixed”; quiddity subject to the condition of exclusion is called “abstracted”; and quiddity without condition is called “unrestricted.”

والإعتباران المذكوران الجاريان في الجزء المشترك ـ أعني أخذَهُ بشرط لا ، ولا بشرط ـ يجريان في الجزء المختصّ.
